implemented_capabilities.capability: Upstream dependency path traversal with critical/non-critical edge flags
implemented_capabilities.notes: Variable-length DEPENDS_ON*1..N (default 4) Cypher returning node chain plus per-edge critical/protocol/latency arrays; builds EvidencePath objects with hop list. Note max_depth is f-string interpolated but is an internal int, not user input.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Heuristic root-cause hypothesis ranking with distractor detection and abstention
implemented_capabilities.notes: Real deterministic scoring: 0.45*topology (critical path, 0.9^hop decay, 0.25 penalty for async/non-critical) + 0.25*temporal proximity bucket + 0.30*telemetry corroboration (alerts/logs/trace-id match); softmax(T=0.25) relative confidence; marks distractors; abstains if best score < 0.60 or no telemetry. Weights and buckets are hand-picked constants, not learned; several 'missing evidence' and 'recommended_verification_steps' strings are hard-coded demo text (e.g. trace id trc-checkout-881).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Time-windowed deployment/alert/log correlation with Cypher provenance
implemented_capabilities.notes: Parameterized Cypher with epoch-ms windows; every response returns the list of executed Cypher strings as provenance.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Ground-truth isolated benchmark (10 synthetic incident scenarios)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Seeds 10 hand-authored incident topologies via Python MERGE helpers; benchmark scores the heuristic against hand-authored ground truth (README claims 9/9 top-1, 8/8 distractor demotion). Because scenarios and scoring weights were authored together, results are demonstrative, not independent validation.
Only implements check_health() (reports whether an API key is configured). No call to any LLM is made anywhere in the investigation path; all reasoning text is templated Python f-strings.

graph_models_and_cypher: FalkorDB graph 'causaltrace'. Labels: Service{id,name,tier,team,language,status}, Deployment{id,version,commit_sha,timestamp,status,deployed_by}, Alert{id,name,severity,timestamp,metric_name,metric_value}, LogEvent{id,level,message,timestamp,trace_id}, Incident{id,title,severity,status,started_at,summary}. Edges: DEPENDS_ON{critical,protocol,latency_p99_ms}, DEPLOYED_TO{environment}, TRIGGERED_ON, EMITTED_BY, AFFECTS, CORRELATED_WITH{time_delta_sec}. Plain openCypher (variable-length paths, nodes()/relationships() comprehension, MERGE, indexes). No APOC/GDS, no FalkorDB algo.* procedures. Queries are parameterized except the f-string depth interpolation and index creation strings built from literals.
algorithms: Depth-capped (4) variable-length upstream path enumeration with per-hop criticality (query.py:traverse_upstream_paths)
Composite scoring 0.45 topology + 0.25 temporal + 0.30 telemetry with 0.9^(hops-1) decay and softmax(0.25) confidence normalization (investigation.py:investigate)
Distractor detection: non-critical path plus high alert or deployment within 10 min (investigation.py)
frontend_interfaces: React/Vite/TS: InvestigationWorkbench, CausalGraphVisualizer, SchemaOverview, HealthStatus, Header
tests_present: backend/tests: test_investigation.py (10), test_evaluation_benchmark.py (3 incl. parametrized), test_falkordb_connectivity.py (3) - about 16 functions (README says 25 passing via parametrization). Tests require a reachable FalkorDB and a seeded graph; no frontend tests.
security_findings: backend/app/api/routes/incidents.py:~66 - POST /api/incidents/seed is unauthenticated and writes (MERGE) to the production graph; any caller can re-seed
backend/app/core/config.py:~10,~22 - APP_HOST defaults to 0.0.0.0 and CORS allow_credentials=True with configurable origins; no authentication on any API route
backend/app/graph/query.py:~96 - f-string interpolates max_depth into variable-length pattern (currently only called with constant 4; unsafe if ever user-controlled)
backend/app/graph/seeder.py:~39 - index creation built with f-string from literal tuples (not user-controlled)
backend/app/api/routes/incidents.py:~36,~55 - exception text including FalkorDB host/port detail is returned to the client (information disclosure)
No hard-coded secrets; LLM_API_KEY read from env only for a health check; no eval/exec/subprocess/pickle
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps Incident & Root Cause Analysis family (AgentAhmed/blast-radius ROOT_CAUSE_CANDIDATES, rootcause-agent, patchpath) with a deployment-correlation scoring variant.
evidence_drift_relevance: LOW - provides evidence paths, supporting/contradictory/missing evidence lists and Cypher provenance for hypotheses, but has no supersession, temporal validity of facts, approval gating or decision lineage.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Self-contained, explainable deployment-correlation scorer that outputs supporting/contradictory/missing evidence, distractor flags and abstention - a useful reference for explainable RCA output schema.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB with seeded Service/Deployment/Alert/LogEvent graph; no LLM needed

strategy_rationale: Heuristic weights are hand-tuned against self-authored synthetic scenarios and the 'AI' provider is a health-check stub; the explainable evidence schema and abstention logic are worth borrowing as a pattern but there is no license file and little unique engine value over blast-radius.
